slides.title:
Nine courses,
one long evening
slides.text: Ingredients picked the same morning, cooked over fire, plated in front of you at the pass.
slides.alt: Seared wagyu fillet with charred leek and bone marrow jus on a dark ceramic plate

slides.title:
Twenty-eight seats,
lit by candle
slides.text: Velvet banquettes, brass light and linen. A room built for the kind of dinner that runs late.
slides.alt: Candlelit dining room with velvet banquettes, brass pendant lights and linen tables

slides.title:
Almost everything
sees the coals
slides.text: The grill is the centre of this kitchen. Sit at the counter and you will feel the heat from it.
slides.alt: Flames rising from a charcoal grill in a dark kitchen

slides.title:
A short list,
made properly
slides.text: Twelve stools, six cocktails, and a wine list that leans to small growers. No reservation needed.
slides.alt: Crystal coupe cocktail with a smoked orange peel on a dark marble bar top
